tools.name: ref_search_documentation
tools.description: Search for documentation on the web or github as well from private resources like repos and pdfs. Use Ref 'ref_read_url' to read the content of a url.

query.description: Query for documentation. Should include programming language and framework or library names. Searches public only docs by default, include ref_src=private to search a user's private docs.

tools.name: ref_read_url
tools.description: Read the content of a url as markdown. The EXACT url from a 'ref_search_documentation' result should be passed to this tool.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to read.

prompts.name: search_docs
prompts.description: A quick way to check technical documentation. This prompt helps you search documentation for any technical platform, framework, API, service, database, or library.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: The rest of your prompt or question you want informed by docs

prompts.name: my_docs
prompts.description: Search through your private documentation, repos, and PDFs that you've uploaded to Ref.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: The rest of your prompt or question you want informed by your private docs
